surface: Release private catalog and migration verification
auth_mode: N/A: operational release path applies to all build modes
permissions: Operator Management API read with server-enforced read_only; no browser-role grant change.
preconditions: The publishable key correctly lacks SELECT on private tool.binding and the migration ledger.
The build-time reader falls back to an authenticated operator path after publishable access is refused.
reproduction: Run the release candidate's docs:tools regeneration under the resource guard.
Observe the publishable read return permission denied 42501 and the fallback report spawnSync supabase ENOENT because the CLI is absent.
Inspect the strict tool-drift and migration checks: both rely on the same fallback and must fail closed if it cannot verify private data.
expected: Build-time catalog and ledger readers use the existing operator's authenticated, read-only Management API access, validate returned rows, and let strict release checks fail closed on refusal or malformed data.
actual: The shared helper invokes a nonexistent Supabase CLI binary. docs:tools warns and leaves its output untouched; strict catalog and migration checks cannot prove private database state through that path.
evidence: tmp/release-logs/latest.log records docs:tools publishable read 401/42501 and fallback spawnSync supabase ENOENT.
scripts/_supabase-management.ts before this fix invoked the supabase binary for all three build-time readers.
docs/stabilization/runs/management-read-probe-001.json records coordinator's authenticated Management API SELECT 1 read_only probe: HTTP 201 and one validated row.
reproducibility_count: 1/1 observed real release regeneration; strict post-fix run pending
severity: S1: strict release cannot verify private catalog and migration state on this host
priority: P0: blocks a truthful strict release
root_cause: The build-time shared reader assumed an installed, authenticated Supabase CLI instead of consuming the existing operator Management API credential at the read point.
sibling_census: The docs:tools generator, strict tool-drift checker, and strict migration ledger checker share this helper; all three callers are converted to await the same authenticated read path.

transition_history.reason: Real release regeneration warned that private catalog read failed and the authenticated CLI fallback was missing.
Coordinator proved the existing operator token can read one row through the official read_only Management API query; the CLI dependency is unnecessary.
Replace shared CLI fallback with fixed-SELECT read_only API request, sanitizing errors and preserving row validation; root owns guarded strict retest.

limitations: No post-fix DB request, tests, build, or release was run by this source-only worker.
The strict gate remains unverified until root's guarded candidate run and independent peer review.
